generation_constraints: each case belongs to exactly one primary family
each case activates at least one non-collapse boundary
at least 30 percent of cases activate two or more boundaries
positive and negative support examples must exist for every positive rule
every family must include supported, unsupported, contradicted, and unknown outcomes
all conditions consume exactly the same atomic fact record
oracle metadata is stored separately from condition inputs
holdout_assignment: sha256(case_id + ':' + holdout_seed) interpreted as unsigned integer; lowest 20 percent by normalized value are holdout
execution_boundary: This grammar may be validated before freeze, but confirmatory cases must not be generated or scored before the final artifact manifest is committed.
